notes:
Lead: Head of Product (Claire Huang). Mid-market analytics SaaS with ML-driven recommendations and in-app conversational assistant. Evaluated Hosted API first; happy with dev ergonomics but needs predictable latency + throughput for peak batch scoring and live chat. Now moving to Dedicated POC to validate latency SLOs, cost predictability, and routing/fallback workflows.

POC goals (as discussed on call):
- Validate canary deploy for model updates (10% traffic -> 100% if metrics good)
- Demonstrate fallback routing: model variant downgrade (quantized model) on capacity issues OR region failover (eu-west -> us-east) without user-visible errors
- Test rollback procedure and automated health checks + tracing (trace IDs tied to requests)
- Confirm KV/prefix caching behavior for chat sessions to maintain sub-200ms token time on typical prompts
- Measure cost delta between Hosted and Dedicated under expected QPS (150 QPS peak, 40 QPS sustained)

Security & compliance notes:
- Must obey customer data residency rule: EU tenant data must remain in eu-west-1 for EU users
- Require SSO (SAML) + SOC2 report + audit logs forwarded to their SIEM (Splunk)
- KMS integration for key management; retention controls for transcripts

Quotes / paraphrases from stakeholders:
- "We like the Hosted API for prototyping, but production needs predictable node capacity and failover policies." - Claire H.
- "Canary + rollback needs to be automated; we cannot have manual ripcords during peak ops." - Eng Manager (Tom Ruiz)

POC acceptance criteria:
- Canary rollout metrics: no regression in 95th latency and acceptably low error rates after 48h at 10% traffic
- Successful simulated region failover with <2% error surface and automated routing switch within 30s
- Rollback completes and restores previous model variant within 2 minutes without session loss

Notes: pricing conversation in progress; asked for firm pricing addendum for Dedicated nodes and expected monthly commit. AE to upload pricing addendum to drive:/deals/zenlytic/zenlytic-dedicated-pricing-v1.pdf
requirements_summary: Workloads: chat (low-latency assistant), embeddings for doc-search, reranking for recommendations. Targets: sustained 40 QPS, burst to 150 QPS; 95th percentile latency target <200ms for token streaming on chat, tail latency SLOs for interactive sessions. Model prefs: open models with quantized variants available; want ability to route to smaller/cheaper variants on congestion. Routing/fallback needs: canary rollout, model-variant fallback, region failover (eu-west <-> us-east), automated rollback triggers (error rate, latency thresholds).
